'''Cori''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Mere]] [[Mere cruiser|cruiser]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]], who fought for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] before the onset of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], she fought in a space battle during the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]].
